title: A failing item in a package that the manifest enumerates first, a healthy package after it
exercises: EXP-555: the remaining packages are skipped, with no manifest entry, directory, definition lookup or message. The Hashtable of the host enumerates `core` before `history` here (EXP-508), although `history` was inserted first, so the failing package comes first and `history` is never exported. The pair with x-abort-after-healthy-package inserts them the other way round.
